speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to begin our assessment, how many weeks pregnant are you and has your fever accompanied by a rash?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The combination of fever, headache, malaise, and anorexia in a 30-week pregnant patient, following consumption of ice cream (a known risk vector for Listeria), is highly suggestive of listeriosis, which can progress to sepsis or meningitis in this population. Immediate empiric treatment with ampicillin is indicated pending confirmatory results.
